entry.current_question: Determine the effective wall thermal resistance R_Th from the C5 graph.

previous_parts.question: Graph the finite-difference rate (T_IC,j-T_IC,j-1)/(t_j-t_j-1) against the corresponding average T_OC-T_IC.

entry.question:
## Physical scenario

Water in the inner and outer cylinders exchanges heat radially through an
acrylic cylindrical wall.  Record T_IC and T_OC versus time.  The heat-flow
model is dQ/dt = (T_OC - T_IC)/R_Th.  For radial Fourier conduction,
dQ/dt = -lambda*A*dT/dr.  Ignore apparatus heat capacity where instructed and
use the dimensions in Figure 17.

## Current subquestion E1-C6

Determine the effective wall thermal resistance R_Th from the C5 graph.
